items.html: And behold, all the days between Rosh HaShanah and Yom Kippur are the aspect of "His left hand under my head," which is the matter of the embrace of the left. And the matter is that the matter of the sawing is the matter of casting away the harsh judgments that are in the Achoraim of the male, and giving them to the female; and he remains Hesed and the Nukva entirely judgment. And in order to mitigate and sweeten the judgments in the Nukva, he embraces her with his left hand, as is known, for judgments are not mitigated except at their root.
